summary: Code-level UX review completed. The composer UI follows DESIGN.md patterns (card-workbook, section-label, accessible labels, semantic buttons). However, the Preview button in LessonComposer.tsx has no onClick handler — it renders as a disabled/enabled button but never navigates to preview mode or toggles a preview state, making FR3 preview inaccessible from the composer. Additionally, the Convex local backend cannot start due to a pre-existing hyphenated filename (content-authoring.ts) that Convex rejects, and the remote deployment lacks CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY for server-side auth, preventing live browser verification of the authenticated composer flow. Four partial screenshots were captured (unauthenticated redirect, login page, post-login redirect, composer edit skeleton). Code review confirms accessibility semantics (aria-label, role=alert, role=status, htmlFor labels) are present but some form fields lack visible labels (phase type select, boolean checkboxes). Array/object/tuple/union field types show only hints with no actual form controls.
blocking_findings: Preview button in LessonComposer.tsx (line ~334) has no onClick handler — renders as a dead button. User clicks 'Preview' expecting to see preview mode, but nothing happens. FR3 (Preview) is inaccessible from the composer UI.

Convex local backend cannot start: convex/teacher/content-authoring.ts has a hyphen in filename which Convex rejects as a module path ('Path component content-authoring.js can only contain alphanumeric characters, underscores, or periods'). This blocks both local dev and deployment push.

Remote Convex deployment (focused-malamute-141) requires CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY for server-side internal function calls. Without it, the login route (/api/auth/login) returns 500, making authenticated browser testing impossible.
nonblocking_findings: Phase type select element (line ~503) has aria-label but no visible <label> element — screen-only users see a bare dropdown without visible context.
Boolean checkbox field (line ~832) has no visible label text next to it — only the field name appears above as a label, but the checkbox itself has no associated label text.
Array field type (line ~853) shows a hint listing item fields but provides no actual input controls for editing array items — teachers cannot populate array props through the form.
Object/tuple/union field types (line ~867) render only italic text with no form controls — teachers cannot configure these activity props.
The StatusStrip 'No status' state (line ~889) renders as a bare section-label with no visual distinction from an active status — could confuse teachers about whether status is loading vs absent.
The composer edit page has no loading skeleton or spinner — the page goes from blank to fully rendered with no progressive disclosure.
evidence: Screenshot 01-unauthenticated-redirect.png: Confirms /teacher/content-authoring redirects to /auth/login when no session cookie exists. Redirect URL includes redirect parameter.
Screenshot 02-login-page.png: Login form renders with Username/Password labels, Sign In button, and Forgot password link. Form follows DESIGN.md patterns.
Screenshot 03-after-login.png: After login attempt, page remains on /auth/login — confirms Convex backend is unreachable (500 on POST /api/auth/login).
Screenshot 04-composer-edit.png: Composer page renders but with no authenticated content — shows login redirect page (auth barrier).

Code review of LessonComposer.tsx (913 lines): Keyboard-operable add/remove/reorder controls, card-workbook shell, section-label per DESIGN.md, accessible labels on inputs, SanitizedText for free-text, status strip with role=status.
Code review of AuthoredLessonPreview.tsx (293 lines): Uses ActivityRenderer for real rendering, role=alert for invalid configs, SanitizedText for free-text, aria-label on phases.
Code review of composer-state.ts: Pure state machine, never mutates arrays, reuses Phase 1 validators, schema-driven form field derivation.
Code review of page.tsx + ClientComposer.tsx: Server-gated route with requireTeacherSessionClaims, preview mode via ?preview=1 URL param, no-op client adapter at this stage.
